ui-ux-design.name: 21st-dev-magic-mcp
ui-ux-design.description: Frontend UI/UX — Browse and use beautiful, production-ready UI components from the 21st.dev marketplace. Provides shadcn/ui, Radix, and Tailwind components with live previews, copy-paste code, and design system tokens.
ui-ux-design.usage: Use for scaffolding UI components, finding design patterns, and generating accessible, responsive frontend code.

github.name: github-mcp-server
github.description: GitHub — Full repository management: create/manage repos, branches, PRs, issues, code search, file operations, and GitHub Actions workflows.
github.usage: Use for all Git operations: creating branches, opening PRs, reviewing code, managing issues, searching repos, and triggering CI/CD workflows.

docker.name: docker-mcp-server
docker.description: Docker — Manage containers, images, volumes, networks, and Docker Compose stacks.
docker.usage: Use for all container operations: building images, running docker-compose, inspecting containers, viewing logs, managing volumes.

aws.name: aws-mcp-server
aws.description: AWS — Interact with AWS services including S3, ECS, RDS, CloudFront, IAM, CloudWatch, Lambda, and Secrets Manager.
aws.usage: Use for all AWS operations: provisioning infrastructure, deploying services, checking CloudWatch logs/metrics, managing IAM roles.

postgres.name: neon-postgres-mcp
postgres.description: PostgreSQL (via Neon) — Full database administration: execute SQL queries, manage schemas, run migrations, inspect tables, analyze query performance.
postgres.usage: Use for all database operations: running queries, creating/altering tables, checking indexes, analyzing slow queries with EXPLAIN.
